dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature fitting a spline that arcs inward from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The morphological peak is rounded with a small pixel radius, transitioning smoothly between the anterior and posterior margins.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: A shallow linear gradient on the anterior margin, measured at approximately 25-30 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The profile displays a high width-to-height ratio of approximately 3:1, characterized by an elongated leading edge base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous white punctate depigmentation marks and small circular speckles on the posterior dorsal surface and the base of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast white spotting pattern concentrated on the posterior half of the visible dorsal region.
